_readme: This project's own shared append-only registries — the kit applied to the
repository that ships it. See starter-kit/rules/shared-registries.md.
id_scheme is 'numeric' rather than the kit's 'slug' default because this
repository's decision records already use ADR-001 and ADR-002, and ADR-001
is cited from starter-kit/README.md. The documented migration procedure is
to freeze identifiers already in use and apply a new scheme only to new
entries — never to renumber what is already cited — so the existing scheme
stays. This is the procedure being followed, not an exception to it.
There is no debugging-knowledge-base registry here: this repository ships
the knowledge-base skeleton as a template rather than keeping one of its
own. A registry is declared when it exists, never speculatively.
